redFirst.basis: `python3 plugins/audit/tests/test_verify_invariants.py --selftest` in a throwaway tree at HEAD exited 1 with 2 of 71 collected tests failing an assertion, the task's own among them (named by --case, HEAD's own tests green on HEAD's code), each passing with the working tree's implementation - rw9 (house FAIL): SELFTEST FAILED: 69/71 cases passed; run without CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR, OLDPWD, PWD; dependencies linked from the project root, entry by entry as symlinks: node_modules - .cache, .vite, .vite-temp are not linked and a new entry a runner makes beside the links stays in the throwaway, but a write into a linked entry lands in the project's own node_modules and is not watched; the user's .npmrc in the home directory dropped (every run has a fresh home)

outcome.technical: Replaced the _REWRITE_ACTIONS regex word search in _invariants.py with a token grammar in _rewrite_action: strip a trailing (phase) marker, whitespace-split, first token is the command; rewrite iff command in rebase/reset/filter-branch, or command is pull with a token --rebase, --rebase=<mode> (not =false) or -r, or message starts with 'branch: Reset to'. Added _pull_rebases helper; docstring states the grammar and why free-text matching was dropped. Tests: rw8 kept, added rw9 (merge fix/reset-flow, pull origin rebase-docs, merge rebase-x, pull origin reset, pull --rebase=false origin main are clean) and rw10 (--rebase=merges, -r, --rebase pull entries are rewrites). Ran python3 plugins/audit/tests/test_verify_invariants.py --selftest: 71/71 passed, exit 0; ruff check on both files clean.
outcome.descriptive: Reflog rewrite detection reads the action's command and flag tokens, so branch names like fix/reset-flow no longer raise false history-rewrite breaches.
